title: Use standard ACP payloads at the consumer boundary
reference: Current Cordyceps conversation, 2026-09-29: user asks whether ACP output follows the ACP specification so the consuming code can use that format, then explicitly requests updating the Saga stories and implementation specification. Agreed clarification: the real harness or adapter emits ACP for the negotiated version; consumers use their normal ACP client/types; observations preserve original payloads; provider controls do not imply an arbitrary fake ACP peer.
